section.content: 本发明的课题是，提供能够容易而且高精度地进行多个输入不同频率的时钟的时钟区之间的相位管理的半导体集成电路。若设A时钟驱动器102、B时钟驱动器103、CMOS缓冲电路119中的时钟的延迟值分别为Ta、Tb、Td，在选择电路114、115、116的端子“0”被选择时，延迟值Ta-Td被存储在寄存电路117中，当切换成端子“1”时，延迟值Ta-Td-Tb被存储在寄存电路118中。因此，借助于设定CMOS缓冲电路119的延迟值，可以设定A时钟驱动器102与B时钟驱动器103的相位差。

Assuming that clocks in an A clock driver (102), a B clock driver (103) and a CMOS buffer circuit (119) have delay values Ta, Tb and Td, respectively, a delay value Ta-Td is stored in a register circuit (117) when terminals '0' of selector circuits (114, 115, 116) are selected, and a delay value Ta-Td-Tb is stored in a register circuit (118) when the terminals '0' are switched to '1'. Thus, determining a delay value at the CMOS buffer circuit (119) allows a phase difference between the A clock driver (102) and B clock driver (103) to be determined.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit, particularly relate to easily and utilize accurately the technology of the phase place management between the synchronous a plurality of clocks district of PLL (phase-locked loop) circuit.

Background technology

Figure 19 is the circuit diagram that the management of the phase place between a plurality of clocks district in the conventional semiconductor integrated circuit of synchronousing working with clock signal is shown.

PLL circuit 501 has reference clock input terminal 506 that is used for the input reference clock and the feedback clock input terminal 507 that is used to import feedback clock.In addition, PLL circuit 501 also has A output terminal of clock 508 that is used to export the A clock, and A output terminal of clock 508 is connected with the input terminal of cmos buffer circuit 510.If the A clock from A output terminal of clock 508 is OUT-A.Cmos buffer circuit 510 has the length of delay Td of the phase place management that is used between the clock district.The efferent of cmos buffer circuit 510 is connected with input terminal as the A clock driver 502 of clock distribution circuit.The A clock that is distributed by A clock driver 502 is transferred into A clock district 504.A clock in the A clock district 504 is input to the feedback clock input terminal 507 of PLL circuit 501.In addition, PLL circuit 501 also has B output terminal of clock 509 that is used to export the B clock.If the B clock from B output terminal of clock 509 is OUT-B.B output terminal of clock 509 is connected with input terminal as the B clock driver 503 of clock distribution circuit.The B clock that is distributed by B clock driver 503 is transferred into B clock district 505.

Work to the circuit of Figure 19 describes below.

PLL circuit 501 generates A clock and B clock with assigned frequency and phase place according to reference clock and the feedback clock that is input to feedback clock input terminal 507 from 506 inputs of reference clock input terminal.The A clock is different with the frequency of B clock, but has consistent phase place.

Postponed to be input to A clock driver 502 behind the Td by cmos buffer circuit 510 from the A clock of A output terminal of clock 508 outputs.A clock driver 502 with the A clock distribution to A clock district 504.In addition, the B clock from 509 outputs of B output terminal of clock is input to B clock driver 503.B clock driver 503 with the B clock distribution to B clock district 505.A plurality of clock distribution to the structure example of semiconductor device inside is published in " USPatent 5; 270; 592 CLOCK SUPPLY CIRCUIT LAYOUT IN A CIRCUITAREA; (the clock supply circuit layout in the circuit region) ", also has circuit at the inner PLL of formation of semiconductor device, the example of clocking publishes in " US Patent 4; 689; 581 INTERGRATED CIRCUIT PHASE LOCKED LOOP TIMINGAPPARATUS (integrated circuit phase-locked loop timing device) " and " 1992 Symposium on VLSICircuits Digest of Technical Papers (very lagre scale integrated circuit (VLSIC) seminar technical papers summary in 1992) pp.84-85, A Dual PLL Based MultiFrequency Clock Distribution Scheme (based on the multifrequency clock distribution scheme of two PLL) ".

In general, need manage, make it keep the phase difference of regulation A clock that is sent to A clock district 504 and the B clock that is sent to B clock district 505.On the other hand, when the length of delay of the length of delay of A clock driver 502 and B clock driver 503 not simultaneously, the A clock that inputs to A clock district 504 is compared then slightly different with the phase difference of the B clock that inputs to B clock district 505 with the phase difference of regulation.So, by means of the length of delay of A clock driver 502 and the length of delay of B clock driver 503 are estimated with breadboardin respectively, 510 settings count its difference at interior desired length of delay Td to the cmos buffer circuit, input to the phase difference management of A clock with the B clock that inputs to B clock district 505 in A clock district 504.

Phase place management between a plurality of clocks district in the conventional semiconductor integrated circuit is carried out with aforesaid mode.Therefore, exist time-consumingly, make the elongated problem of during the design for electricity consumption road simulated estimation length of delay.

In addition, because evaluated error is bigger, thereby the problem that also exists phase place management precision to reduce.

Summary of the invention

The present invention carries out for addressing the above problem, and its purpose is to provide the semiconductor integrated circuit of can be easily and carrying out the phase place management between the clock district of clock of a plurality of input different frequencies accurately.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 1st aspect of the present invention comprises: the PLL circuit that generates the 1st clock and the 2nd clock; The 1st clock driver with above-mentioned the 1st clock distribution to the 1 clock district; The 2nd clock driver with above-mentioned the 2nd clock distribution to the 2 clock districts; The 1st that dispose on the bit comparison loop mutually, the 1st variable delay circuit that its retardation is set by the output of above-mentioned phase-comparison circuit that are comprising above-mentioned the 1st clock driver and phase-comparison circuit; The 2nd that dispose on the bit comparison loop mutually, the 2nd variable delay circuit that its retardation is set by the output of above-mentioned phase-comparison circuit that are comprising above-mentioned the 2nd clock driver, above-mentioned the 1st variable delay circuit and above-mentioned phase-comparison circuit; At above-mentioned the 1st phase bit comparison loop and the above-mentioned the 2nd selection circuit that switches between the bit comparison loop mutually; And the phase difference importing circuit that is used for due prescribed phases difference between above-mentioned the 1st, the 2nd clock district is reflected in the retardation of above-mentioned the 2nd variable delay circuit.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 2nd aspect of the present invention is the described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 1st aspect, and it is the delay circuit that is provided with in above-mentioned the 1st phase bit comparison loop that above-mentioned phase difference imports circuit.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 3rd aspect of the present invention is the described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 1st aspect, and it is the above-mentioned PLL circuit that generates above-mentioned the 1st, the 2nd clock with the phase difference that equates with the phase difference of afore mentioned rules that above-mentioned phase difference imports circuit.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 4th aspect of the present invention is the described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 1st aspect, and above-mentioned phase difference imports circuit and comprises: the delay circuit that is provided with in above-mentioned the 1st phase bit comparison loop; And the above-mentioned PLL circuit that generates above-mentioned the 1st, the 2nd clock with phase difference littler than the phase difference of afore mentioned rules.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 5th aspect of the present invention is the described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 1st aspect, it is the above-mentioned phase-comparison circuit that is made of the 1st, the 2nd phase-comparison circuit with different balance points that above-mentioned phase difference imports circuit, and these two different balance points have the phase difference suitable with the phase difference of afore mentioned rules.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 6th aspect of the present invention is in the described semiconductor integrated circuit in any one aspect aspect the 1st to the 5th, also comprises the lock detecting circuit of the switching that is used to control above-mentioned selection circuit.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 7th aspect of the present invention is the described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 6th aspect, and above-mentioned PLL circuit comprises above-mentioned lock detecting circuit.

The described semiconductor integrated circuit in the 8th aspect of the present invention is in the described semiconductor integrated circuit in any one aspect aspect the 1st to the 5th, also comprises the counting circuit of the switching that is used to control above-mentioned selection circuit.

(embodiment 1)

Fig. 1 is the circuit diagram that the management of the phase place between a plurality of clocks district in the semiconductor integrated circuit of the embodiment of the invention 1 is shown.

PLL circuit 101 comprises reference clock input terminal 106 that is used for the input reference clock and the feedback clock input terminal 107 that is used to import feedback clock.In addition, PLL circuit 101 also comprises A output terminal of clock 108 of output A clock.If the A clock from A output terminal of clock 108 is OUT-A.

A output terminal of clock 108 is connected with input terminal as the A clock driver 102 of clock distribution circuit via contact A.The A clock that is distributed by A clock driver 102 is transferred into A clock district 104.The feedback clock that A clock in the A clock district 104 inputs to PLL circuit 101 is transfused to terminal 107 and zero-input terminal of selecting circuit 116.In addition, PLL circuit 101 also comprises B output terminal of clock 109 that is used to export the B clock.If the B clock from B output terminal of clock 109 is OUT-B.

B output terminal of clock 109 is connected with the input terminal of variable delay circuit 111 via contact B.The lead-out terminal of variable delay circuit 111 is connected with the input terminal of B clock driver 103.The B clock that is distributed by B clock driver 103 is transferred into B clock district 105.B clock in the B clock district 105 is input to one-input terminal of selecting circuit 116.

A output terminal of clock 108 of PLL circuit 101 is connected with the input terminal of the cmos buffer circuit 119 of the desired length of delay Td with the phase place management that is used between the clock district via contact A.This cmos buffer circuit 119 carries out work as being used for that the phase difference of desired phase difference importing variable delay circuit 111 between the clock district 104,105 is imported circuit.The lead-out terminal of cmos buffer circuit 119 is connected with zero-input terminal of selecting circuit 114.Select one-input terminal of circuit 114 to be connected with B output terminal of clock 109 of PLL circuit 101 via contact B.

Select the lead-out terminal of circuit 114 to be connected with the input terminal of variable delay circuit 110.The lead-out terminal of variable delay circuit 110 is connected with the input terminal 131 of phase-comparison circuit 112.If inputing to the clock of the input terminal 131 of phase-comparison circuit 112 is IN-A.Select the lead-out terminal of circuit 116 to be connected with the input terminal 132 of phase-comparison circuit 112.If inputing to the clock of the input terminal 132 of phase-comparison circuit 112 is IN-B.

The lead-out terminal of phase-comparison circuit 112 is connected with the input terminal of selecting circuit 115.Select " 0 " lead-out terminal of circuit 115 to be connected with the input terminal of register circuit 117, the lead-out terminal of register circuit 117 is connected with control input end of variable delay circuit 110.By means of the control code that is input to this control input end, variable delay circuit 110 can change its retardation.That is, carry out work as the 1st variable delay circuit.

Select one-output terminal of circuit 115 to be connected with the input terminal of register circuit 118, the lead-out terminal of register circuit 118 is connected with control input end of variable delay circuit 111.By means of the control code that is input to this control input end, variable delay circuit 111 can change its retardation.That is, as the 2nd variable delay circuit work.

In addition, the selection signal input terminal of selecting signal to select circuit 114,115,116 from selecting signal input terminal 113 to be inputed to respectively.

Work to the circuit of Fig. 1 describes below.In addition, figure 5 illustrates sequential chart.

PLL circuit 101 generates the frequency of regulation and the A clock and the B clock of phase place according to reference clock and the feedback clock that inputs to feedback clock input terminal 107 from 106 inputs of reference clock input terminal.The A clock is different with the frequency of B clock, but has consistent phase place.

Fig. 2 shows a structure example of PLL circuit 101.PLL circuit 101 comprises: phase-comparison circuit 151, loop filter 152; Voltage control oscillating circuit 153; And frequency divider 154,155.Phase-comparison circuit 151, carry out bit comparison mutually from the reference clock of reference clock input terminal 106 inputs with the feedback clock that inputs to feedback clock input terminal 107.Comparative result becomes control voltage through loop filter 152, the vibration of control voltage control oscillating circuit 153.The vibration output of voltage control oscillating circuit 153 is divided down to A clock and B clock and output in frequency divider 154,155.

Return Fig. 1 again, select circuit 114,115,116, can between terminal " 0 " and " 1 ", switch by means of from selecting the selection signal of signal input terminal 113 inputs.By preestablishing by means of the moment of selecting signal to switch, this switching can be carried out automatically.

At first, select " 0 " terminal of circuit 114,115,116 effective by means of selecting signal to make.At this moment, input to the input terminal 131 of phase-comparison circuit 112 via cmos buffer circuit 119, selection circuit 114, variable delay circuit 110 from the A clock of A output terminal of clock 108 outputs.In addition, also input to the input terminal 132 of phase-comparison circuit 112 via A clock driver 102, A clock district 104, selection circuit 116 from the A clock of A output terminal of clock 108 outputs.By means of this work, formed the 1st phase bit comparison loop.

Fig. 3 shows a structure example of phase-comparison circuit 112.Phase-comparison circuit 112 comprises phase difference detecting circuit 162 and code device 163.The phase place occasion more leading at the clock IN-A that has been transfused to than the phase place of IN-B, output signal from phase difference detecting circuit 162 is the H level signal, and, be the L level signal from the output signal of phase difference detecting circuit 162 in the phase place of the clock IN-A that has been transfused to occasion than the phase lag of IN-B.Code device 163 forms length of delay control signal (sign indicating number) according to the signal that has been transfused to, and exports it to register 117 (or 118), and register 117 (or 118) exports variable delay circuit 110 (or 111) to after the length of delay control signal is stored.

Fig. 4 shows the structure of variable delay circuit 110,111.Export from lead-out terminal 182 via phase inverter 171, phase inverter 172 from the clock signal of input terminal 180 inputs.Be input to the input part of the grid of NMOS of transmission gate 183,185,187 that transmission gate circuit 174,175,176 etc. had etc. and phase inverter 184,186,188 etc. via signal distribution circuit 173 from the length of delay control signal of input terminal 181 input.Be input to the grid of the PMOS of transmission gate 183,185,187 etc. from the output of phase inverter 184,186,188 etc.That is, transmission gate circuit 174,175,176 etc. are by means of making capacitor 177,178,179 etc. be connected with the efferent of phase inverter 171 according to the length of delay control signal, and phase inverter 171 is applied load, thereby increase length of delay.Therefore, can produce according to the length of delay control signal that has been transfused to and postpone.

Here, utilize Fig. 5 that the variation that is applied to the length of delay of A clock in variable delay circuit 110 is described.

If the initial delay value of variable delay circuit 110 is VDL1, the length of delay in the cmos buffer circuit 119 is Td.In addition, establishing the clock IN-A of terminal " 0 " when selected is clock IN-A0, and its initial condition is clock IN-A01.Thereby the phase difference of clock IN-A01 and clock OUT-A is Td+VDL1.On the other hand, when establishing the clock IN-B of terminal " 0 " when selected and be clock IN-B0, the phase difference of clock IN-B0 and clock OUT-A is the length of delay Ta of A clock driver 102.Phase-comparison circuit 112 outputs are corresponding to the length of delay control signal of the phase difference of clock IN-A01 and clock IN-B0.Therefore, when establishing when being clock IN-A02 through the clock IN-A0 after the adequate time, this clock IN-A02 is just the same with clock IN-B0, with the phase difference of clock OUT-A be Ta.At this moment, the length of delay that is produced by variable delay circuit 110 is Ta-Td, and this length of delay is stored in the register 117.

Secondly, by means of selecting signal to make " 1 " terminal of selection circuit 114,115,116 for effective.At this moment, be input to the input terminal 131 of phase-comparison circuit 112 via selection circuit 114, variable delay circuit 110 from the B clock of B output terminal of clock 109 outputs.In addition, also be input to the input terminal 132 of phase-comparison circuit 112 via variable delay circuit 111, B clock driver 103, B clock district 105, selection circuit 116 from the B clock of B output terminal of clock 109 outputs.By means of this work, formed the 2nd phase bit comparison loop.

Below, utilize Fig. 5 that the variation that is applied to the length of delay of B clock in variable delay circuit 111 is described.

If the initial delay value of variable delay circuit 111 is VDL2, the length of delay in the B clock driver 103 is Tb.In addition, establishing the clock IN-B of terminal " 1 " when selected is clock IN-B1, and its initial condition is clock IN-B11.Thereby the phase difference of clock IN-B11 and clock OUT-B is Tb+VDL2.On the other hand, when establishing the clock IN-A of terminal " 1 " when selected and be clock IN-A1, then the phase difference of clock IN-A1 and clock OUT-B is the Ta-Td of storage in register circuit 117.Phase-comparison circuit 112 outputs are corresponding to the length of delay control signal of the phase difference of clock IN-B11 and clock IN-A1.Therefore, when establishing when being clock IN-B12 through the clock IN-B1 after the adequate time, then this clock IN-B12 is just the same with clock IN-A1, with the phase difference of clock OUT-B be Ta-Td.At this moment, the length of delay that is produced by variable delay circuit 111 is Ta-Td-Tb, and this length of delay is stored in the register 118.

Afterwards, when working usually, the retardation of the A clock that A clock district 104 is supplied with is Ta, and the retardation of the B clock that B clock district 105 is supplied with is Ta-Td-Tb and Tb sum, is Ta-Td.

According to above work, can be with its phase place than being dispensed to super previous clock distribution by the length of delay Td that produces in the cmos buffer circuit 119 in the A clock district 104 to B clock district 105.

Like this, in the semiconductor integrated circuit of present embodiment 1, have the cmos buffer circuit of the length of delay of desiring to carry out the expectation of phase place administrative institute by means of setting, need not just can carry out the phase place management between the clock district easily and accurately with the length of delay in each clock district of circuit simulated estimation.

(embodiment 2)

Fig. 6 is the circuit diagram that the management of the phase place between a plurality of clocks district in the semiconductor integrated circuit of the embodiment of the invention 2 is shown.

The circuit of Fig. 6 has adopted and do not used cmos buffer circuit 119 in the circuit of Fig. 1, and A output terminal of clock 108 directly is connected with zero-input terminal of selecting circuit 114, and replaces the structure of PLL circuit 101 with PLL circuit 121.PLL circuit 121 is the same with PLL circuit 101, gets structure shown in Figure 2, but is provided with voltage control oscillating circuit 191 to replace voltage control oscillating circuit 153.

In Fig. 7, show the structure of voltage control oscillating circuit 191.The annular oscillation circuit 192 that voltage control oscillating circuit 191 comprises oscillation control circuit 193 and will couple together by means of the odd number phase inverter 194 that oscillation control circuit 193 changes length of delay, this voltage control oscillating circuit 191 produces phase difference by means of the different parts that frequency divider 154,155 is connected annular oscillation circuit 192 between A clock and B clock.That is, PLL circuit 121 carries out work as being used for that the phase difference of desired phase difference importing variable delay circuit 111 between clock district 104 and 105 is imported circuit.This phase difference is not with length of delay, but the angle when being converted into 360o with the cycle of oscillation with annular oscillation circuit 192, promptly phase angle is represented.Therefore, the occasion that manages as the phase place of length of delay between to the clock district can be converted into length of delay with phase angle.

In the circuit of Fig. 6, to Fig. 1 in the key element that will have identical function be marked with identical symbol, except that in PLL circuit 121, producing phase difference Td, carry out the work identical with embodiment 1.Therefore, the detailed description here is omitted.

The circuit of Fig. 9 has adopted in the circuit of Fig. 1 the lead-out terminal with phase-comparison circuit 112 to be connected with the input terminal of lock detecting circuit 122, with the lead-out terminal of lock detecting circuit 122 through latch circuit 300 and the structure of selecting signal input terminal 113 to be connected.

Figure 10 shows the syndeton of phase-comparison circuit 112 and lock detecting circuit 122.This is the structure that also inputs to lock detecting circuit 122 from the phase difference of phase difference detecting circuit 162 outputs.

Here, latch circuit 300 has in the occasion from breech lock testing circuit 122 input " 1 " and keeps " 1 ", the occasion from 122 inputs " 0 " of breech lock testing circuit do not change keep the function of content.Therefore, after switching to terminal " 1 " from terminal " 0 ", even be not 0 occasion at the phase difference of clock IN-A0 and clock IN-B0, returning to terminal " 0 " do not taken place yet.

In Figure 10, show an example of latch circuit 300.When lock detecting circuit 122 outputs " 1 ",, to phase inverter 303 outputs " 0 ", export " 1 " to selection signal input terminal 113 from phase inverter 303 from phase inverter 302 to phase inverter 302 inputs " 1 ".Owing to the grid that also inputs to PMOS transistor 301 from the output " 0 " of phase inverter 302, PMOS transistor 301 is conducting state, so the current potential at resistance 304 two ends is the H level, does not flow through electric current in resistance 304.Secondly, when 122 outputs " 0 " of lock detecting circuit under this state, electric current flows into resistance 304 from power supply potential, produces voltage drop.Therefore, to be input as " 1 " of phase inverter 302, the maintenance content of latch circuit 300 is constant, to selecting signal input terminal 113 outputs " 1 ".
